summary.text: A.J. Louderback is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 30 since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia notes he is also known as Andy and lists his profession as law enforcement officer.

paragraphs.text: A.J. Louderback's career experience includes working as the sheriff of Jackson County.

According to a Ballotpedia excerpt of his campaign website, he is a veteran of the U.S. Air Force, a five-term Jackson County sheriff, and a 35-year law enforcement officer who served on the National Sheriffs' Association Immigration Committee and Governmental Affairs Committee.
Louderback succeeded Geanie Morrison in the Texas House, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
